advice: No supported change identified. Keep the existing legal SME function boundaries and ZA setup. The supplied evidence has no measurements that isolate streaming-region entry, exit, or ZA setup costs, so it does not support changing those boundaries or combining transpose and GEMM. Any proposed change would need an independent source review and a complete-call paired measurement against a fresh AC baseline, with correctness checked at n=512 and odd-tail sizes.
risks: Combining work in one streaming region may reduce entry and exit overhead, but may also increase live ZA state or complicate function boundaries. The evidence does not show whether that overhead matters relative to packing and GEMM time. Prior battery scores are noisy and cannot establish causality or performance.
